title: Project Aegis Experiment Definition
description: INF-6.1 / DRG-257 headless experiment definition consumed by ProjectAegis.Delegation.Demo --batch --experiment. scenarioId, seeds, and ticks drive BalticReplayHarness.Run. doctrineId, roeId, and forceRatioId are opaque strings recorded on CSV rows; the seed-grid stub does not apply them to the simulation.

schemaVersion.description: Document version. Omit to mean version 1. Any other integer is invalid.

scenarioId.description: Scenario policy id passed to the headless harness (for example baltic-patrol).

ticks.description: Headless tick count for every grid point.

seeds.description: Seed grid. Every seed is executed. Order is preserved.

side.description: Side the CSV score columns are tallied for. Defaults to BLUE when omitted.

mvpEngagement.description: Passed through to BalticReplayHarness.Run as mvpEngagement. Defaults to true.

doctrineId.description: Opaque doctrine id. Recorded on each row when doctrine is not swept.

roeId.description: Opaque ROE id. Recorded on each row when ROE is not swept.

forceRatioId.description: Opaque force-ratio id. Recorded on each row when force ratio is not swept.

grid.description: How swept axes combine. cartesian is the full product. latin-hypercube is a deterministic discrete sample whose size is the longest active axis.

parameters.description: Axes allowed to vary. seed is always executed in full. Omit to vary every axis that has sweep values.

sweeps.description: Discrete levels for opaque swept parameters. Empty or omitted axes use the matching scalar id.
